hook.rumour: In the Foreign Quarter and St. Olms canals of Vivec City, chalk drawings of twin lanterns appear beside locked sewer grates while bounty-hunters from Dren Plantation prowl the bridges toward Suran.
hook.notice: OFFICE OF ARCHCANON SARYONI, HIGH FANE OF VIVEC — Discreet mediator sought to investigate the underworks disturbances between Vivec City, Pelagiad, and Suran.
hook.context: In the lush Ascadian Isles, the golden cantons of Vivec City rise above slave-worked plantations and a secret abolitionist railroad moving through the underworks toward Seyda Neen.

quests.title: Chalk Marks on St. Olms Canal

stages.objective: Inspect the twin-lantern chalk marks in the underworks of Vivec City
Meet the pilgrim courier waiting beside the muck-shrine at Fields of Kummu
Speak with the sympathetic Legion quartermaster inside Fort Pelagiad at Pelagiad

objectives.text: Inspect the twin-lantern chalk marks in the underworks of Vivec City
Meet the pilgrim courier waiting beside the muck-shrine at Fields of Kummu
Speak with the sympathetic Legion quartermaster inside Fort Pelagiad at Pelagiad

consequence_detail.summary: The courier at Fields of Kummu and the quartermaster at Pelagiad reveal that a Camonna Tong informant has sold out a Twin Lamps safe-route near Dren Plantation.

stages.objective: Slip into the guard-house at Dren Plantation and seize the slave-hunters' ambush roster
Free the detained Khajiit and Argonian labourers held at Arvel Plantation
Warn the Twin Lamps ferryman waiting by the river-landing at Suran

objectives.text: Slip into the guard-house at Dren Plantation and seize the slave-hunters' ambush roster
Free the detained Khajiit and Argonian labourers held at Arvel Plantation
Warn the Twin Lamps ferryman waiting by the river-landing at Suran

consequence_detail.summary: The ambush roster is seized from Dren Plantation, the labourers at Arvel Plantation are freed, and the Suran ferryman redirects the refugees.

stages.objective: Defeat the hired syndicate manhunters blocking the hill-pass at Marandus
Secure the outbound ship-papers at the Census and Excise office in Seyda Neen
Register the Imperial manumission seals at Castle Ebonheart

objectives.text: Defeat the hired syndicate manhunters blocking the hill-pass at Marandus
Secure the outbound ship-papers at the Census and Excise office in Seyda Neen
Register the Imperial manumission seals at Castle Ebonheart

consequence_detail.summary: The manhunters at Marandus are scattered and lawful manumission papers are stamped at Seyda Neen and Castle Ebonheart.

stages.objective: See the freed passengers safely aboard the coastal packet at Seyda Neen
Deliver the manumission register to Archcanon Saryoni at the High Fane in Vivec City
Receive the Pilgrim's Lantern of Grace on the Temple steps of Vivec City

objectives.text: See the freed passengers safely aboard the coastal packet at Seyda Neen
Deliver the manumission register to Archcanon Saryoni at the High Fane in Vivec City
Receive the Pilgrim's Lantern of Grace on the Temple steps of Vivec City

consequence_detail.summary: Archcanon Saryoni upholds the Temple sanctuary charter in Vivec's cantons and the Twin Lamps passage to Seyda Neen remains unbroken.
